In [[mathematics]],  '''Gram's theorem''' states that an [[algebraic set]] in a [[finite-dimensional vector space]] invariant under some [[linear group]] can be defined by [[absolute invariant]]s. {{harvs|last=Dieudonné|last2=Carrell|year1=1970|loc=p. 31}}. It is named after [[Jørgen Pedersen Gram|J. P. Gram]], who published it in 1874.
